```python
def wire_valid(c, f):
    # returns (ok, is_ack, psn, payload)
    L=len(f)
    if L<58: return None
    if f[12:14]!=b'\x08\x00': return None
    if f[14]!=0x45: return None
    if f[23]!=17: return None
    flags=struct.unpack('!H',f[20:22])[0]
    if flags not in (0x0000,0x4000): return None
    if checksum(f[14:34])!=0: ... hmm wire.py's checksum computes over data and returns ~sum; for validation: checksum of header including checksum field should be 0xffff... let me just: s=sum of u16s; fold; must == 0xffff.
    ip_total=struct.unpack('!H',f[16:18])[0]
    if L!=ip_total+14: return None
    if ip_total<44: return None
    if f[34:36]!=b'\x12\xb7' or f[36:38]!=b'\x12\xb7': return None
    if struct.unpack('!H',f[38:40])[0]!=ip_total-20: return None
    if f[40:42]!=b'\x00\x00': return None
    op=f[42]
    if op not in (4,0x11): return None
    if f[43]!=0: return None
    if f[44:46]!=b'\xff\xff': return None
    qpn=struct.unpack('!I',f[46:50])[0]
    if qpn>>24: return None
    apsn=struct.unpack('!I',f[50:54])[0]
    psn=apsn&0xffffff
    if op==4:
        if apsn>>24!=0x80: return None
        if ip_total!=44+4*c.D: return None
        payload=f[54:54+4*c.D]
    else:
        if apsn>>24!=0: return None
        if ip_total!=48: return None
        if f[54]!=0x1f: return None
        if struct.unpack('!I',f[54:58])[0]&0xffffff != (psn+1)&0xffffff: return None
        payload=None
    # ICRC
    crc_in=bytearray(b'\xff'*8+f[14:-4])
    crc_in[9]=255;crc_in[16]=255;crc_in[18:20]=b'\xff\xff';crc_in[34:36]=b'\xff\xff';crc_in[40]=255
    if struct.unpack('<I',f[-4:])[0]!=zlib.crc32(bytes(crc_in)): return None
    return (op==0x11, psn, payload)
```
